desc:
✈️ VOXEL PLANES ✈️

Fly 17 planes, from the tiny Cessna 172 to the giant 747, the Concorde and the F-16. Then land them... or crash them in spectacular ways!

💥 REAL VOXEL DAMAGE. Every plane and building breaks apart block by block. Wings rip off, fuselages tear open, and buildings get smashed holes you can see into.

🚨 EMERGENCIES: Pick an engine fire, hydraulic loss, jammed gear or all engines out, and land safely for up to 3x points. Crash and you get nothing!

🏆 Land to earn Landing Points and unlock bigger planes.
💰 Crash to earn Crash Coins for liveries and upgrades.

🎮 Simple mode: fly with your mouse, like other plane games.
🛫 Realistic mode: real cockpits, autopilot, ATC and transponder.

🌍 Fly over islands, cities and airports. Fly a fighter jet with missiles, and watch replays of your best crashes.

📱 Works on PC, mobile and console!
